_comment: The feeling taxonomy the free tools run on. It is deliberately WIDER than the shelf: a tool has to be able to name what someone is in, even when there is nothing to sell them for it. Every feeling therefore carries `product` — the purchasable mood it resolves to — which may be a different slug, and `productNote` explains the hop honestly when it is. Nothing here invents a product.

feelings.name: Calm
feelings.shortDescription: For when everything feels too loud.
feelings.whyFits: Calm isn't the absence of the noise. It's two minutes where none of it is asking anything of you.

feelings.name: Peace
feelings.shortDescription: For when the noise finally stops and you don't know what to do with the quiet.
feelings.whyFits: Peace is the part after. Not solved — just no longer being pulled at.
feelings.productNote: Peace doesn't have its own piece yet. Calm is the one that goes there.

feelings.name: Nostalgia
feelings.shortDescription: For when you miss a version of your life that doesn't exist anymore.
feelings.whyFits: You don't miss the place. You miss who you got to be there.

feelings.name: Love
feelings.shortDescription: For when someone occupies your thoughts.
feelings.whyFits: Not the romance-novel kind. The kind where a person keeps turning up in your ordinary hours.
feelings.productNote: Love is being written now. Until it's finished, Nostalgia is the closest thing on the shelf — it's about a person you can't go back to.

feelings.name: Joy
feelings.shortDescription: For when you forgot you're allowed to feel good.
feelings.whyFits: You've been treating it as something to earn back. It isn't.
feelings.productNote: On the shelf this one is called Happiness.

feelings.name: Hope
feelings.whyFits: The change starts before there's any proof of it. That's the whole argument.

feelings.name: Hurt
feelings.whyFits: It isn't the moment that keeps stinging. It's what the moment revealed.

feelings.name: Sorrow
feelings.shortDescription: For the days that feel heavier than usual.
feelings.whyFits: Nobody is going to rush you toward the door marked fine.

feelings.name: Grief
feelings.shortDescription: For someone or something you still carry with you.
feelings.whyFits: The habits that haven't caught up yet aren't a failure to move on.

feelings.name: Rage
feelings.shortDescription: For the feeling you don't know where to put.
feelings.whyFits: You've been reasonable for a long time. This one isn't going to ask you to be.

feelings.name: Loneliness
feelings.shortDescription: For being in a room and still not being with anyone.
feelings.whyFits: Loneliness isn't about how many people are nearby. It's about being unseen by them.
feelings.productNote: Loneliness is being written now. Sorrow is the piece that sits with you in the meantime — it doesn't try to fix anything either.

feelings.name: Anxiety
feelings.shortDescription: For when your head won't stop running the same three minutes.
feelings.whyFits: The loop isn't solving anything. It's just loud, and it's convinced you it's useful.
feelings.productNote: Anxiety is being written now. Calm is the one that helps tonight — it slows the loop instead of arguing with it.
